prompts.tfe:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square PS4 homebrew game library icon, finished illustrated cover art, 1024x1024.
Create an exciting premium illustrated icon for the classic game Serious Sam: The First Encounter. Serious Sam is the central heroic figure, muscular adult man with short dark hair, black sunglasses, white T-shirt bearing a red bomb emblem, holding a large minigun. Egyptian pyramids, monumental sandstone temple and obelisks behind him, blazing amber sunset and swirling desert dust. Strong gold, burnt orange and red palette with deep charcoal shadows. Crisp painterly videogame key art, energetic adventurous slightly humorous classic shooter feeling. Powerful simple silhouette, dramatic rim light, readable when reduced to 512x512 or smaller. No gore. Full bleed square artwork, no rounded corners, no mockup or device frame.
Typography: big beautifully integrated legible bold title "SERIOUS SAM", with exact subtitle "THE FIRST ENCOUNTER". Keep all lettering comfortably inside the square with safe margins. No other text, no platform logo, no watermark. Compose as a complete standalone icon, not a collage.
